About Siacoin

Siacoin is the native coin of Sia, a decentralized storage network where hosts rent out disk space and are paid in SC under smart contracts.

Where this SC price comes from

The price above updates live in your browser from Binance (SC/USDT) and Kraken (SC/USD), and the badge shows which exchange reported the latest trade. Market cap is the live price × a circulating supply of about 56.03B SC (supply last updated October 30, 2026).
